candidates.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: source-faithful hand-painted HD foreground fragment for Legend of Dragoon EnvHD. Edit FIRST reference, preserving its exact viewpoint, camera, canvas aspect, framing, silhouette, all internal landmark positions, object counts, lighting and native palette. Twin Castle exterior curved pale-stone balcony front. At extreme upper-left, narrow pale edge rises vertically out of crop and curves down into the long gently bowed horizontal edge, then turns slightly upward toward cropped right edge. Retain FOUR small pale round inset accents along the purple/turquoise horizontal decorative stripe at the original positions. Far-left end has dark blue oval/recessed panel with small clustered pale-gold marks; reproduce their source arrangement without changing them into a recognizable new emblem, text or flower. Maintain original multiple separate narrow nested pale stone bands, dark blue gaps, blue-purple central stripe with turquoise fine lines, original stone joint positions and exact curvature. Subtle cool weathered cream stone grain, soft blue-violet inset, no new masonry courses, extra circular dots or exaggerated seams. Entire long rail must span crop width; no trimming the upper-left tip, no straightening or thickening bands.
candidates.reason: Exterior balcony left inset retains an invented central four-petal gold emblem and tidy ring of marks, not established by original small irregular marks. Version2 correction failed to remove it. Technical footprint passes do not clear the semantic hold. The version1 prompt miscounted pale stripe insets as four; fresh enlarged source crop confirms five, also present in both paintings.
